occurrences.text: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

identityBasisJa: NUM26:28はヨセフの子らの系譜でマナセを個人名として挙げ、26:29はその子ら、マキル、ギレアデと続く。人口調査・部族集団のbaseは残し、族祖個人の系譜部分を同一IDの別contextとして提案。
decision: propose a personal ancestor context alongside the collective tribe base
